card.name: Partway through drug and long words
card.fires_on: Pieces in the middle of long drug or medical names, such as Strep-t-ococcus, misop-rost-ol, PHE-XX-I and PREV-YM-IS. Also fires on a few stray spots like a digit inside a number or the word 'to' after a clause.

card.writes: It seems to hold back risk and safety words like 'risks' and 'Warnings' while favoring a few unrelated words, so the effect is weak.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long, split-up drug and medical names, not on ordinary words.
